errors.text_span: 在x约为$0.15 \times 10^7$处触及约-1.8的全局最低点
errors.evidence: The description states the global minimum is approximately -1.8, but visually, the lowest point on the graph is closer to -1.75. More importantly, the end point of the line at x~1.05 is also around -1.7, making it difficult to definitively claim the point at x=0.15 is the global minimum. The description also gives a value of -1.7 for the endpoint, creating an internal contradiction with the claim that -1.8 is the global minimum. While -1.8 is a plausible estimate, stating it as the definitive global minimum is an overstatement and potentially inaccurate.

The description states the line ends at a y-value of approximately -1.7. Visually, the end point appears to be closer to -1.8, and certainly lower than the y-axis tick for -1.5. This estimate is slightly off.
